model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories within Approximate Number Generation, specifically focusing on different types of relationships and quantifiers. The chart is divided into seven slices, each representing a different category. These categories are ‘Disjunctive &Conjunctive’ (light blue), occupying 49.51% of the chart; ‘Conjunctive’ (grey), accounting for 50.49%; ‘Comparative Relationships’ (orange), representing 36.26%; ‘Approximate Quantities’ (pink), at 45.03%; ‘Absolute Absence’ (light purple), at 18.71%; ‘Limiter’ (yellow), at 27.91%; and ‘Existential Quantifiers’ (green) at 15.12%, while ‘Universal Quantifiers’ (dark blue) representing 29.07%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice, and a legend is provided to identify each category. The segments appear ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion.
